description: §5.5.4 Axiom ① — `class=(@mode)` (a wholesale writer of the whole `class` attribute) and `class:active=@active` (a per-class writer) on one `<div>` fire E-ATTR-WRITER-CONFLICT: the next `class=` write would erase the toggled class.
rationale: §5.5.4 "Exclusive wholesale ownership (Axiom ①)": "`class=(expression)` is a WHOLESALE writer of the element's `class` surface … It SHALL be the SOLE writer of that surface on its element. If a `class:name=` directive (§5.5.2) or a transition directive … also targets `class` on the SAME element, the compiler SHALL emit `E-ATTR-WRITER-CONFLICT` (§34) naming both sites". Presence only — the report's span and wording are impl freedom. Its clean twin is class-directive-toggle-rt (a STATIC `class="card"` beside `class:` directives, which §5.5.2 says SHALL NOT be treated as a conflict).
